App responses: GET /acme document 200 and GET /acme.data 200 fetched both with curl (kody session cookie) and in-browser with credentials - 'Dashprobe' count 0 in both, no nextArrivals/totalCovers/waitlistCount, no localhost:3007/3009 URL, no JWT, only control-plane location names; /tmp/menuza-logs/app.log has zero /operator/reservations hits. assertions.limitations: The contract's literal check 'the document response contains only tokenUrl, tenantApiUrl, locations' does not match this build: the loader payload has no tokenUrl/tenantApiUrl at all - the block mints through the same-origin App route /<org>/reservations/token?scope=book and reads tenantApiUrl from that response (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/reservations-client.ts; block-data.server.ts passes only the picker's {available, locations}). The substance of the check holds (no guest data, no regional counts, no token or regional URL in the App payload; the regional call is made by the browser with an rsv+jwt Bearer). The network-detail command does not embed response bodies in this agent-browser build, so the body greps come from curl and in-page fetch of the same routes with the same session.
